comparison.objective: Arrange instruments on a sterile field while avoiding its one-inch unsterile border, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Contamination-aware instrument placement and boundary avoidance, not fine mechanical unlocking and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Instruments remain within the sterile region rather than repeated safe carriage stops and setting retention.
comparison.reason: The manipulation objective and failure modes are materially different despite both requiring precision.
